page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is-2x.8xlarge is an accelerated compute instance belonging to the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 256 GB of system RAM, providing an allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per core.

Hardware acceleration is delivered via two NVIDIA L20 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace family, offering a combined 96 GB of VRAM across both cards. The instance has no local storage bundled, necessitating external block storage for data persistence. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, while zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

With a dual-GPU configuration, a high 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, and dedicated compute cores, this instance is suited for GPU-accelerated computing pipelines, model serving, and deep learning inference. The absence of local NVMe storage requires architectural reliance on network storage, but the resource density is structured for workloads that demand significant GPU memory and substantial host system memory.
